description: Claim form for Employees' Deposit Linked Insurance (EDLI) Scheme benefit — filed by nominee/legal heir after the death of an EPFO member while in service.

fields.name: Name of Claimant (Nominee / Legal Heir)
fields.description: Full name of the person claiming the EDLI insurance benefit.

fields.name: Relationship with Deceased
fields.description: Your relationship to the deceased member (eg. Wife, Son, Daughter, Mother, Father).

fields.name: Date of Birth of Claimant
fields.description: Date of birth of the claimant in DD/MM/YYYY format.

fields.name: Name of Deceased Member
fields.description: Full name of the EPFO member who has passed away.

fields.name: Father's / Husband's Name of Deceased
fields.description: Father's or husband's name of the deceased member as per EPFO records.

fields.name: Date of Death
fields.description: Exact date of death of the member in DD/MM/YYYY format.

fields.name: Date of Joining Service
fields.description: Date on which the deceased had joined the establishment.

fields.name: Date of Leaving Service (if applicable)
fields.description: Leave blank if death occurred while in service. Otherwise enter last working day.

fields.name: Name & Address of Last Establishment
fields.description: Name and full address of the company or factory where the deceased last worked.

fields.name: PF Account Number / UAN
fields.description: UAN or PF account number of the deceased employee.

fields.name: Bank Account Number of Claimant
fields.description: Your bank account number where the insurance amount should be credited.

fields.name: IFSC Code
fields.description: IFSC code of the claimant's bank branch.

fields.name: Bank Name and Branch
fields.description: Full name of the bank and branch where account is held.

fields.name: Mode of Payment
fields.description: Select: ECS (NEFT/RTGS) for bank transfer — most common method.

fields.name: Claimant Signature / Thumb Impression
fields.description: Signature or left thumb impression with date.

fields.name: Certificate by Employer / Authority
fields.description: To be filled by the last employer certifying service details and cause of death.
